home.description: User data directory to use. Corresponds to the PAN_HOME environment variable.

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode. Corresponds to the --verbose command-line flag.

debug.description: Run in debug mode. Corresponds to the --debug command-line flag.

debug_ssl.description: Run in TLS/SSL debug mode. Corresponds to the --debug-ssl command-line flag.

nzb_output_dir.description: Path to save attachments listed in NZB files. Corresponds to the -o/--output option.

server_host.description: Hostname of the primary Usenet server.

server_port.description: Port number of the primary Usenet server.

server_ssl.description: Whether to use SSL/TLS for the primary server connection.

extra_servers.description: List of additional Usenet server host:port strings for multi-server support.

ssl_cert_dir.description: Directory to search for SSL certificates. Corresponds to SSL_CERT_DIR.

ssl_alt_dir.description: Additional directory to search for SSL certificates. Corresponds to SSL_DIR.
